page_title: AST 1-0 MCI | Aston Villa v Manchester City 06/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' John McGinn (Aston Villa) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
90+5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Aston Villa.
90+4' John Brooks blows for a foul after Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+2' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) is penalised for holding. John Brooks signals a set piece.
90+2' Corner kicks – 6:0.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Ollie Watkins and he is replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
90' It will be a substitution. Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) is ready to enter the pitch as Lucas Digne walks off.
89' Flag up against Kyle Walker (Manchester City). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
89' 22:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
88' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
87' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
86' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) is coming onto the pitch as Leon Bailey cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) replaces Youri Tielemans.
84' The game is interrupted now, Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
82' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and the ball is aimed to the bottom left corner, but Emiliano Martinez is alert and thwarts the effort.
81' John Brooks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Diego Carlos (Aston Villa). Manchester City earn a free kick.
80' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
80' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
79' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa)! That was a huge opportunity! Aston Villa will take a corner kick.
79' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
78' John McGinn (Aston Villa) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
77' John McGinn (Aston Villa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when John Brooks blows for a foul.

76' The most active player in today's match is definitely Leon Bailey (Aston Villa). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
74' 1 - 0 Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Ederson. 1:0.
73' Substitution. Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) on for Phil Foden.
73' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) attempts to find Josko Gvardiol, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
72' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
71' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement.
70' Shots on target – 4:2.
68' Substitution. Julian Alvarez did his best and is replaced by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
68' Substitution. Rico Lewis walks off the pitch and Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
68' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.

67' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
66' The Aston Villa players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
65' John McGinn (Aston Villa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
65' Ball possession – 45:55.
64' That was close. John McGinn (Aston Villa) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
63' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) swings it in and Ollie Watkins gets on the end of it, but Ederson shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
62' Surely that's handball by one of the Manchester City players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

62' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Now Aston Villa have a corner.
60' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) picks up a yellow card.
59' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
59' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and John Brooks blows for a foul.
58' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
58' The ball is cleared after Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
56' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Phil Foden (Manchester City) heads on.
55' John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempts to release Lucas Digne with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
54' The Aston Villa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
53' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
49' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Phil Foden (Manchester City) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' John Brooks has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Phil Foden, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' John Stones (Manchester City) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
44' Total attempts – 12:2.
43' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
42' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
41' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
40' A crossfield pass from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates.
40' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
39' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
38' Manchester City are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
36' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
34' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

32' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
31' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) fails to beat the offside trap. The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle.

30' Douglas Luiz sends the free kick into the box. Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.

28' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Aston Villa are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
28' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
26' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
24' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

24' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it. Aston Villa have a corner.
24' A rebound falls for John McGinn (Aston Villa), who immediately lets rip with a howitzer of a shot from distance. The effort, however, is bravely blocked by a defender.
23' The resulting corner, taken by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa), comes to nothing.
23' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Ederson. Aston Villa get a corner.
22' John Stones (Manchester City) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
21' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 36:64.
20' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
19' John Brooks blows the whistle, Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul.
18' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
17' John McGinn (Aston Villa) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
16' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) tries to find John McGinn, but he puts too much power on the pass.
14' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
13' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
12' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Erling Haaland (Manchester City) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
11' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Emiliano Martinez.

11' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester City will take a throw-in.
9' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
7' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Pau Torres (Aston Villa) who directs his shot to the left side of the goal, but the keeper is there in time to stop his effort.
7' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

6' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Ederson stops the ball out of the bottom right corner. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
6' Neat passing move from Aston Villa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' So close! Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
3' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
John Brooks is the one to supervise the game today.
